name: sotp_implied_value_per_share
question_template: Use exact arithmetic. A target is valued on a sum-of-the-parts basis. Segment A EBITDA is {EBITDA_A} USD million at a comparable multiple of {MULT_A} times; Segment B EBITDA is {EBITDA_B} USD million at a multiple of {MULT_B} times. Net debt is {NET_DEBT} USD million (a negative value means net cash), minority interest is {MINORITY} USD million, and diluted shares outstanding are {SHARES} million. Enterprise value is the sum of the two segment values. Equity value equals enterprise value minus net debt minus minority interest. Compute the implied equity value per share in USD.

slots.description: Segment A value from its EBITDA multiple.
Combined enterprise value of both segments.
Equity value after net debt and minority interest.

program:
def solve():
    ebitda_a = Q(P["EBITDA_A"])
    mult_a = Q(P["MULT_A"])
    ebitda_b = Q(P["EBITDA_B"])
    mult_b = Q(P["MULT_B"])
    net_debt = Q(P["NET_DEBT"])
    minority = Q(P["MINORITY"])
    shares = Q(P["SHARES"])
    if shares <= 0:
        raise ValueError("shares must be positive")
    seg_a = ebitda_a * mult_a
    seg_b = ebitda_b * mult_b
    ev = seg_a + seg_b
    equity = ev - net_debt - minority
    if equity <= 0:
        raise ValueError("equity value must be positive")
    per_share = equity / shares
    return {
        "final": per_share,
        "segment_a_value": seg_a,
        "sotp_enterprise_value": ev,
        "implied_equity_value": equity,
    }
